static_findings.description:
Reentrancy in VulnerableBank.withdraw(uint256) (contracts/reentrancy.sol#11-16):
	External calls:
	- (success,None) = msg.sender.call{value: _amount}() (contracts/reentrancy.sol#13)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- balances[msg.sender] -= _amount (contracts/reentrancy.sol#15)
	VulnerableBank.balances (contracts/reentrancy.sol#5) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- VulnerableBank.balances (contracts/reentrancy.sol#5)
	- VulnerableBank.deposit() (contracts/reentrancy.sol#7-9)
	- VulnerableBank.withdraw(uint256) (contracts/reentrancy.sol#11-16)

Version constraint ^0.8.0 contains known severe issues (https://solidity.readthedocs.io/en/latest/bugs.html)
	- FullInlinerNonExpressionSplitArgumentEvaluationOrder
	- MissingSideEffectsOnSelectorAccess
	- AbiReencodingHeadOverflowWithStaticArrayCleanup
	- DirtyBytesArrayToStorage
	- DataLocationChangeInInternalOverride
	- NestedCalldataArrayAbiReencodingSizeValidation
	- SignedImmutables
	- ABIDecodeTwoDimensionalArrayMemory
	- KeccakCaching.
It is used by:
	- ^0.8.0 (contracts/reentrancy.sol#2)

Low level call in VulnerableBank.withdraw(uint256) (contracts/reentrancy.sol#11-16):
	- (success,None) = msg.sender.call{value: _amount}() (contracts/reentrancy.sol#13)
Parameter VulnerableBank.withdraw(uint256)._amount (contracts/reentrancy.sol#11) is not in mixedCase
